title: Agree new rate for kerb removal and re-laying on widened road section
description: The variation widens internal road R-101 over 600 m and shifts the kerb line. The BOQ has no rate for kerb removal and re-laying (R-02-050), so a new rate must be agreed under clause 13.3 before valuation can be finalised.
reason: Clause 13.3 requires a new rate only where no similar item exists; the kerb work has no BOQ rate and needs commercial agreement.
